feed.title: Stop Using This: verified updates
feed.subtitle: New recalls from CPSC, NHTSA and FDA, in the agencies' own words.

entry.title: FDA recall: Rocky Mountain Nutrition Issues Allergy Alert on Undeclared Milk in Certain Pre-Workout Powders
entry.summary: Rocky Mountain Nutrition LLC is voluntarily recalling certain Santa Cruz Paleo Pineapple Caffeine and Island Punch Caffeine Pre-Workout Powder products because they contain milk that is not declared on the label. People who have an allergy or severe sensitivity to milk run the risk of serious or life-threatening allergic reaction if they consume these products. Official FDA record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: FDA recall: Fresh & Ready Foods LLC Expands Recall to Include Fresh to You Brand Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwich and Meals Made in Minutes Brand Biscuit & Sausage Gravy Due to Possible Health Risk
entry.summary: LONGVIEW, Texas, November 17, 2026 — Fresh & Ready Foods LLC is expanding its November 8th recall of select Fresh To You Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwiches to now include the additional products listed below produced at Fresh & Ready’s Longview, Texas facility. This recall is due to the expansion of C.H. Guenther & Son’s recall of certain biscuit products that may be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes . Official FDA record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: FDA recall: bioQuad Life Sciences Issues Allergy Alert on Undeclared Milk in OsteoDenx® Dietary Supplement
entry.summary: “This is an update to the company’s press release, previously issued on 11/13/2026. This update adds two additional UPC codes for cartons sold on a third-party retailer’s website.” Official FDA record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: FDA recall: Naia, Inc. Recalls Chocolate Banana Bar Sorbetto Because of Undeclared Milk, Eggs, and Nuts
entry.summary: Naia, Inc. of Hercules, CA is recalling Chocolate Banana Bar Sorbetto with code dates of 10/5/2027, 10/6/2027, 10/7/2027, and 10/8/2026, because it may contain undeclared tree nuts (pistachio), milk, and egg allergens. People who have an allergy or severe sensitivity to tree nuts (pistachio), milk or eggs run the risk of serious or life-threatening allergic reaction if they consume these products. Official FDA record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: FDA recall: ALDI Recalls Priano Protein Carbonara Tortelloni and Priano Protein Herb & Cheese Tortelloni Because Of Possible Health Risk
entry.summary: ALDI of Batavia, IL, is recalling Priano Protein Carbonara Tortelloni and Priano Protein Herb & Cheese Tortelloni sold at select stores because the products may not have been stored, distributed or sold at appropriate temperatures, which may allow growth of pathogens including Clostridium botulinum (" C. botulinum "), a bacterium which can cause life-threatening illness or death. Official FDA record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: FDA recall: Larbi Inc. Recalls Yellow Dock Root Because of Possible Health Risk
entry.summary: Larbi Inc. of Valley Cottage, NY, is recalling three lots of Herb To Body Yellow Dock Root C/S 4oz, because it has the potential to be contaminated with Salmonella , an organism which can cause serious and sometimes fatal infections in young children, frail or elderly people, and others with weakened immune systems. Official FDA record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.summary: Medline shares new customer communication, provides instructions for continued use and additional information about options for repair, replacement and full or partial refund of original purchase price Official FDA record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: FDA recall: Eros Apothecary Issues Recall of Candy Power For Man Organic Honey Due to Undeclared Tadalafil
entry.summary: Eros Apothecary of Indio, California is recalling Candy Power For Man Organic Honey because the product was found to contain undeclared tadalafil. Official FDA record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: FDA recall: Game Changer Products LLC Issues Voluntary Nationwide Recall of 10 Day Forecast Capsules Due to the Presence of Undeclared Sildenafil and Acetaminophen
entry.summary: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE – November 12, 2026 - Tampa, Florida . Game Changer Products LLC is voluntarily recalling all lots of 10 Day Forecast capsules to the consumer level. FDA analysis has found the product to be tainted with sildenafil and acetaminophen. Sildenafil is an active ingredient in an FDA-approved prescription drug product, used to treat erectile dysfunction. Official FDA record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: CPSC recall 27088: Boshengya Recalls Rugs Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standard for Carpets and Rugs
entry.summary: This recall involves Boshengya-branded rugs. The pink or orange shag area rugs measure about 5 or 6 feet wide and 8 feet long. ‘INCREDIBLY SOFT’ is printed on a label on the product packaging. Hazard: The recalled rugs violate the mandatory standard for the flammability of carpets and rugs, posing a risk of serious injury or death from fire hazard. Remedy: Consumers should stop using the rugs immediately and contact Boshengya for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to destroy the rug by cutting it in half and send a photo of the destroyed rug to boshengya666@outlook.com. Consumers will then dispose of the recalled product. Official CPSC record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: CPSC recall 27087: Cummins Recalls Portable Generators Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fire and Burn Hazards
entry.summary: This recall involves the Cummins Onan P5000iDF EFI Dual Fuel Portable Generators sold in a dark gray color. The generators can operate on gasoline or propane, and produce between 4,500 and 5,000 watts, depending on fuel. “Cummins” is printed in white on the front of the unit and the handle above the control panel. The Cummins "C" logo and "Onan P5000iDF EFI" are printed on the side. The model and part number can be found on the label attached to the side of the generator. Hazard: The valves in the recalled generators were installed incorrectly, preventing fuel vapors from venting properly from the gasoline tank, causing excessive pressure to build up. This pressure can cause fuel to discharge or the fuel cap to eject, posing a risk of serious injury from fire and burn hazards. Remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled portable generators immediately and go to https://www.cummins.com/en-na/na/generators/portable-generators/safety-recalls/campaigns/7308 to check if the model and part number is included in the recall. If your unit is affected, contact an authorized Cummins service location and arrange for a free repair at the service location. To find a service location near you, please use the Service Locator link at https://quickserve.cummins.com. Official CPSC record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: CPSC recall 27086: Huffy Recalls Buzz Bicycles Cerana T2 E-Trikes Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fall Hazard
entry.summary: This recall involves Buzz Bicycles Cerana T2 E-Trike, model E4004. The tricycle is a pedal assist tricycle. The tricycle is gray with "BUZZ" logos on the left and right side. The tricycle has a 500-Watt motor and a 48-Volt battery. The tricycle has three 24-inch wheels. The model number is printed on a label near the pedals on the bottom side of the frame’s downtube. Hazard: The recalled tricycles’ rear wheels can become loose or separate from the rear frame, posing a risk of serious injury from a fall hazard. Remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled tricycles immediately and contact Huffy for free replacement rear axle assemblies. The rear wheel axle assemblies will be sent directly to consumers or to a third-party who will repair the tricycle. Huffy Corporation will reimburse consumers up to $100 for charges incurred by the third-party repair. Official CPSC record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: CPSC recall 27085: Kakgold Recalls 4WD Remote-Controlled Car Toys Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys
entry.summary: This recall involves the Kakgold 4WD stunt vehicles with a remote-control containing button cell and lithium-ion batteries. The toy car has a lime green and blue body, a black chassis and four black wheels with lime green trim and diagonal rollers. The vehicle body features checkered patterns, an “X” design and the words “PRO” and “RACING.” A white hang tag attached to the vehicle body displays “Do Not Twist the Shaft” in red lettering and illustrations marked with red crosses. Hazard: The recalled remote-controlled cars violate the mandatory standard for toys because they contain button cell and lithium-ion batteries in the remote control that can be easily accessed by children, posing a deadly ingestion hazard to children. When button cell or coin batteries are swallowed, the ingested batteries can cause serious injuries, internal chemical burns and death Remedy: Consumers should stop using the remote-controlled car toys immediately and contact Kakgold for information on how to receive a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write “RECALLED” on the product and email a photograph showing the product being properly disposed of in the trash to kakrecall@outlook.com. Note: Button cell batteries are hazardous. Batteries should be disposed of or recycled by following local hazardous waste procedures. Official CPSC record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: CPSC recall 27084: QIOMALA Pressure Washers Recalled Due to Serious Risk of Injury or Death from Shock and Electrocution Hazards
entry.summary: This recall involves QIOMALA-branded pressure washers with model number “HWT12P”. The 1.2 GPM electric pressure washers were sold in green with black and in blue with black and measure about 14 inches deep, 11 inches wide and 15 inches high. The pressure washers came with a 500 ml soap tank, four quick disconnect nozzles and a 20-foot hose. Model number “HWT12P” is printed on a label on back of the unit, near the power cord entry point. Hazard: The recalled pressure washers lack an adequate-length power cord, which can encourage use of an extension cord, posing a serious risk of injury or death from shock and electrocution hazards. Remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled pressure washers immediately and contact QIOMALA for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to unplug the pressure washer, cut the power cord in half and send a photo of the destroyed power washer, showing the model number, to QIOMALA@163.com. Consumers should then dispose of the destroyed recalled product. Official CPSC record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: CPSC recall 27083: SHEIN Distribution Corporation Recalls Baby Rattle and Teether Toy Sets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Choking; Violate Mandatory Small Parts Ban
entry.summary: This recall involves Baby Rattle and Teether Toy Sets. The sets include seven toys in a variety of pastel colors and shapes. SKU “sk25070936134444119” is located on the upper right corner of a label on the product packaging. Hazard: The recalled toy sets violate the small parts ban because they are intended for children under three years old and the purple and orange knobs can detach from the product, posing a deadly choking hazard to young children. Remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled toy sets immediately, take them away from children, and contact SHEIN for a refund. Consumers will be asked to affirm they disposed of the toy sets to receive a refund. Official CPSC record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: CPSC recall 27082: Allstar Recalls Sharper Image Tabletop and Infinity Fire Pits Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Burn and Fire Hazards
entry.summary: This recall involves outdoor Sharper Image-Branded Tabletop Fire Pits and Sharper Image-Branded Tabletop Infinity Fire Pits. The units have a “77” logo on the front, a Lot Code sticker in the center of the base, a round black sticker marked “CHINA” with a 5-digit code, the letters KS-CY or KS-FC, and a date code in YYYY-MM-DD format. The Sharper Image-Branded Tabletop Fire Pits feature a small cylindrical concrete body with a removable snuffing lid and an open burn chamber at the top. The Sharper Image-Branded Tabletop Infinity Fire Pits feature a steel base and tempered‑glass side panels. Hazard: Ignited flammable liquid can escape from the recalled fire pits or trigger flame jetting from the fuel containers, posing a risk of serious injury from burn and fire hazards. Remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled fire pits immediately and contact Allstar for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to register at www.firepitrecall.expertinquiry.com, write “RECALLED – DO NOT USE” in permanent marker, and submit three photographs following the instructions on Allstar’s recall page. After registration is confirmed, consumers should dispose of any remaining fuel in accordance with local hazardous-waste requirements and discard the recalled fire pits safely. Official CPSC record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.summary: Worcester, New York – Family Farmstead Dairy is recalling all cheddar cheese products because it has the potential to be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes , an organism which can cause serious and sometimes fatal infections in young children, frail or elderly people, and others with weakened immune systems. Official FDA record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: FDA recall: Laub's Feeding & Cubing, Inc. Voluntary Recalls Grade A Mini Hay Cubes Because of Potential Clostridium Botulinum Contamination
entry.summary: Laub’s Feeding and Cubing, Inc. of Beryl, Utah is voluntary recalling up 89 ton of Grade A Mini Hay Cubes sold from October 3 – October 31 because the product has the potential to be contaminated with Clostridium botulinum , a bacterium that can cause botulism, leading to severe and potentially fatal toxicity in animals that consume contaminated food. Official FDA record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: FDA recall: Eugia US LLC (f/k/a Auro Medics Pharma LLC) Issues Voluntary Nationwide Recall of Vancomycin Hydrochloride for Injection USP 1.25g/Vial-30mL (Single Dose Vial) Due to Presence of Particulate Matter
entry.summary: November 06,2026 – East Windsor, New Jersey, Eugia US LLC (f/k/a Auro Medics Pharma LLC) is voluntarily recalling lot number 3VM26026A of Vancomycin Hydrochloride for Injection USP 1.25g/Vial-30mL (Single Dose Vial) to the hospital/healthcare facility/user level due to the presence of particulate matter identified as a glass particle inside the vial. Official FDA record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: FDA recall: Fresh & Ready Foods LLC Recalls Fresh To You Brand Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwich due to Possible Health Risk
entry.summary: November 7, 2026, Fresh & Ready Foods LLC of Renton, WA is recalling 2,414 of Fresh To You Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwiches (4.6 oz) because it has the potential to be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes , an organism which can cause serious and sometimes fatal infections in young children, frail or elderly people, and others with weakened immune systems. Official FDA record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: CPSC recall 27076: Magnetopia Recalls Magnetic Building Cubes and Blocks Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion Hazard
entry.summary: This recall involves Magnetopia-branded Magnetic Building Cubes and Blocks, which are magnetic cubes sold in sets of 60, 100, 150 and 200. The cubes contain small, powerful magnets that allow the cubes to stick together and create 3D designs. The sets are available in a variety of themed building/landscape designs and colors. The following styles and models are included in the recall: Style Name Model Number Darkhouse MAT-030 Arean MAT-031 Darkgrass MAT-032 Farmday MAT-033 Bluehous MAT-034 Pinkfarm MAT-035 DarkForest MAT-036 PinkHouse MAT-037 Seafight MAT-038 Firefarm MAT-039 Darkfarm MAT-040 Darkhouse T009 BrownFarm T025 Farm T076 Darkhero T078 The model numbers of the recalled cubes are located on the back of the product packaging. Hazard: The recalled magnetic building cubes contain magnets that can become loose if the cubes break or open, posing a magnet ingestion hazard to children. When high-powered magnets are swallowed, the ingested magnets can attract each other, or other metal objects, and become lodged in the digestive system. This can result in perforations, twisting, and/or blockage of the intestines, blood poisoning and death. Remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled magnetic building cubes immediately and contact Magnetopia for a full refund. Consumers will be provided with a pre-paid label to return the recalled magnetic cubes to receive a refund. Official CPSC record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: CPSC recall 27074: U.S. Titan Recalls X-Pro Youth All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs) Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Crash Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standard for ATVs
entry.summary: This recall involves X-Pro Eagle youth ATVs. The gas-powered, 110cc vehicles were sold in black, blue, red, pink, spider black, spider blue, spider red, leaf pink and tree camo. “X-PRO” is printed on the ATV’s side panel and “This ATV is subject to Titan Imports Inc.’s Action Plan approved by the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission” on a plate on the left front side of the frame. Hazard: The recalled ATVs violate the mandatory ATV safety standard because the speed-adjusting module included with the vehicle allows for the ATV’s speed to be adjusted in excess of the maximum speed for vehicles intended for children 6 years old and older, posing a risk of serious injury or death from a crash. Remedy: Consumers should stop using the speed-adjusting module included with the vehicle immediately and contact X-PRO for a $100 refund. Consumers can continue using the vehicle without the module. Consumers will be asked to return the module using a prepaid shipping label. Official CPSC record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: CPSC recall 27073: Sanven Technology Recalls Vevor BMX Bicycles Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Crash Hazard; Violate Federal Requirements for Bicycles
entry.summary: This recall involves Vevor-branded 20-inch and 24-inch BMX bicycles, models SS24001 and SS24002. The model numbers are printed on the product packaging. The bicycles were sold in black. The Vevor logo is printed across the downtube of the frame on the bikes. Hazard: The bicycles violate the mandatory safety regulation for bicycles, because they are not equipped with a chain guard. Loose clothing can get entrapped in the chain drive, posing a risk of serious injury or deadly crash hazard. In addition, the bicycles do not comply with the labeling requirements. Remedy: Consumers should stop using the BMX bicycles immediately and contact Sanven Technology for a free repair kit. Consumers will be shipped free chain guards, with detailed installation tutorials and provided with after-sales support (such as customer service email) to help solve any issues arising during self-installation. Official CPSC record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: CPSC recall 27072: Baby Brezza Enterprises Recalls SuperFast Sterilizer Dryers Due to Overheating and Burn Hazards
entry.summary: This recall involves the SuperFast Sterilizer Dryer, a countertop appliance that uses a push-button control to sterilize and dry baby bottles, breast pump parts and accessories in ten minutes. The recalled units have model numbers BRZ0083, BRZ0154 and BRZ0156. The model number is printed on the product label located on the bottom of the unit. Hazard: The recalled sterilizer dryers can overheat when plugged in and operating, posing a risk of injury from a burn hazard if the surface is handled. Remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled sterilizer dryers immediately and contact Baby Brezza Enterprises for a free replacement sterilizer dryer, including shipping at no cost to the consumer. Consumers will be asked to register at https://babybrezza.com/pages/about?view=v3-recalls, complete the recall form, unplug the product, cut the power cord to destroy the sterilizer dryer and upload photos. Send photos of the model number on the label of the dryer the destroyed appliance and the return authorization number to recall@babybrezza.com. After uploading the photos, consumers should dispose of the recalled sterilizer dryers in accordance with local and state ordinances. Official CPSC record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: CPSC recall 27071: Kikea Store Recalls X-VESOLJE Nursing Pillows Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Suffocation; Violate Mandatory Standards for Nursing Pillows
entry.summary: This recall involves X-VESOLJE Nursing Pillows, model number NP001. The nursing pillows are C-shaped and sold in white with leaves pattern, dark brown with multicolored feather pattern and multicolored puzzle piece pattern. There are no markings or labels on the product. Hazard: The recalled nursing pillows violate the mandatory safety standards for nursing pillows because they can obstruct an infant’s breathing, posing a serious risk of injury or death from suffocation. Remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled nursing pillows immediately and contact Kikea Store for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to cut the pillow in half after confirming the recalled pillow with the firm and send a photo of the destroyed pillow to zsally929@gmail.com. Consumers should then dispose of the product. Official CPSC record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: CPSC recall 27070: C.A.M.P. Recalls Mountain Ice Axes Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fall Hazard
entry.summary: This recall includes X-Dream, X-Dream Total Dry, X-All Mountain Hammer and X-All Mountain Adze. These products are designed for vertical ice climbing. The batch number is located on the side of the shaft. “CAMP” is written in white lettering on the ice axes shaft. The recalled nut and bolt kit were also sold as an accessory item as model number 3641. Recalled Models and Batches • X-Dream (model: 3570): Batches 10/24, 07/25, 10/25, 12/25 • X-Dream Total Dry (model: 3609): Batches 10/24, 07/25, 11/25 • X-All Mountain Hammer (model: 3630): Batches 10/24, 09/25 • X-All Mountain Adze (model: 3631): Batches 10/24, 09/25 • Accessory Kit (nut and bolt) (model: 3641) Hazard: A screw on the recalled mountain ice axes can loosen during use, causing the handle or pick to detach, posing a risk of serious injury or death from fall hazard. Remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled mountain ice axes immediately and register at https://www.camp-usa.com/x-bolt-recall-102026 to receive a free repair kit. Consumers should have the model and batch number available, which can be found on the side of the axes’ shaft. Consumers can either contact C.A.M.P. for a free repair kit with instructions to repair the axes themselves or have the firm repair the ice axes. The firm will send the consumer a prepaid shipping label and packaging to return the recalled axes to the firm. Official CPSC record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: CPSC recall 27069: Gourmia Recalls 9-Slice Digital Air Fryer Ovens Due to Burn Hazard
entry.summary: This recall involves Gourmia 9-SliceDigitalAir Fryer Ovens with model number GTF7530, and UPC Code 810002862779. The recalled ovens are stainless steel and have two spring-loaded glass front French doors with metal handles. The Ovens can be identified with model and UPC codes on packaging. The Model number GTF7530 and codes 3021 to 0126 can also be found on a label on back of the unit. Hazard: The oven’s doors can unexpectedly close when bumped, posing a burn hazard to consumers retrieving hot food. Remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled Ovens immediately and contact Gourmia for a free repair kit by mail. The repair kit will include an added doorstop and instructions on how to install. Official CPSC record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: CPSC recall 27068: Jiastfeng Recalls HAUOMS Eight-drawer Dressers Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Violate Mandatory Standard for Clothing Storage Units
entry.summary: This recall involves HAUOM-branded Eight-drawer dressers. The wooden black dressers measure about 27.6 inches wide, 15.8 inches long, 59.1 inches tall, and weigh about 112.4 pounds. "SKU: AJ_DJ504298_1" is printed on the product packaging. Hazard: The recalled dressers are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in risks of serious injuries or death to children. The dressers violate the mandatory safety standards as required by the STURDY Act. Remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled dressers immediately if they are not anchored to the wall, place them in an area that children cannot access and contact Jiastfeng for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write in permanent marker “RECALLED” on the top, front and sides of the dresser, remove all drawers and send photos of the marked and disassembled dresser to recall@hauoms.com. Consumers should then dispose of the product. Official CPSC record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: CPSC recall 27067: Little Giant Recalls Ladders with Rapid Locks Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fall Hazard
entry.summary: This recall involves Little Giant ladders with Rapid Locks. Rapid Locks are designed to insert into ladder rungs for the purpose of adjusting the ladder’s height. Rapid Locks are black or orange and are located on each ladder leg. The affected models are Adjustable Fortress 2.0, Conquest 2.0, Dark Horse 2.0, Epic, King Kombo XT, Leveler, MegaLite, MegaLite+, Multi, Quantum and Vector. The brand name Little Giant and the model name are located on the side of the ladder. Only ladders without an orange rectangular “QC” sticker on the rail above one of the Rapid Locks are included in this recall. Hazard: The ladders can suddenly retract if the Rapid Locks are not fully engaged, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled ladders immediately until they review the information at www.littlegiantladders.com/pages/recalls or via the QR code on the ladder and contact Little Giant for a repair kit containing warning labels and instructions. The additional instructions and labels, which should be affixed to the ladder, advise consumers to verify that their Rapid Locks are properly engaged before every use and to maintain their locks with lubrication. Consumers who follow the provided instructions and have a Rapid Lock that does not function properly after the application of lubrication should contact Little Giant for evaluation. If a lock does not function properly after this evaluation, the company will offer the choice of a replacement ladder of the same or equivalent model or a refund ranging from a depreciated value determined by date of purchase up to full purchase price for ladders purchased within the past 12 months. Official CPSC record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: CPSC recall 27066: Arlopu Recalls Slide Playsets Due to Risk of Serious Injury and Death from Head and Neck Entrapment Hazards
entry.summary: This recall involves Arlopu Slide Playsets with model numbers KT-CS17 and LY-31. The plastic playsets are designed for indoor or outdoor use and contain multiple activity components, including a slide and a basketball hoop. The playsets are available in tan, red, blue, yellow, gray and green. Model number KT-CS17 is printed on a label located on the underside of the elevated platform of the playset. Model LY-31 is printed on a label located on the upper back panel behind the slide of the playset. Hazard: The recalled products contain multiple openings where a child’s torso can fit through the opening, but a child’s head cannot, posing a risk of serious injury and death due to head and neck entrapment hazards. Additionally, the basketball nets on the recalled products with model number KT-CS17 can come unhooked from the rim, forming a loop large enough for a child’s head, posing entanglement and strangulation hazards. Remedy: Consumers should stop using the Arlopu Slide Playsets immediately and store them away from children. Contact Arlopu for a free repair kit, which includes redesigned panels, basketball hoops and installation instructions. Consumers will be asked to provide a photo of the product showing the model number to arlopu_support@163.com. Upon receipt of the photo, the firm will mail the free repair kit directly to consumers. Once the repair has been completed, consumers should write “RECALLED” with permanent marker on the removed components and dispose of the removed components. Official CPSC record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: CPSC recall 27065: Bose Recalls Lithium-Ion Battery Packs for S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ Bluetooth Speaker Systems Due to Risk of Injury from Fire and Overheating Hazards
entry.summary: This recall involves lithium-ion rechargeable battery packs intended for use with Bose S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ Portable Bluetooth Speaker Systems. The serial number of the battery packs included in this recall begins with any one of the following six digits: 083723, 078352, 084105, 078591, 078592, 084106, or 086409. The 17-digit serial number for the battery pack is printed on a label placed at the bottom of the battery pack. The affected battery packs were sold with S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ Portable Bluetooth Speaker Systems and sold separately as accessories or replacement parts. Hazard: The recalled lithium-ion battery packs can overheat and ignite, posing a risk of injury from fire and overheating hazards. Remedy: Consumers should remove the recalled battery packs installed in any S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ Portable Bluetooth Speaker Systems and stop using the battery packs immediately. Once the battery pack is removed, consumers may continue to use their S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ Portable Bluetooth Speakers while connected to AC power. Consumers will be asked to register and provide the affected battery pack’s serial number at www.support.bose.com/s1-battery-recall to receive a free replacement battery pack. For battery packs that are not installed in the speaker systems, consumers can simply view the serial number and provide that number to the website listed above. Consumers should dispose of the affected battery pack in accordance with local and state regulations. Note: Do not throw this recalled lithium-ion battery pack in the trash, the general recycling stream (e.g., street-level or curbside recycling bins), or used battery recycling boxes found at various retail and home improvement stores. Recalled lithium-ion batteries must be disposed of differently than other batteries because they present a greater risk of fire. Your municipal household hazardous waste (HHW) collection center may accept this recalled lithium-ion battery pack for disposal. Before taking your battery pack to a HHW collection center, contact that office ahead of time and ask whether it accepts recalled lithium-ion batteries. If it does not, contact your municipality for further guidance. Official CPSC record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: CPSC recall 27064: Vanderhall North America Recalls All Model Year 2024-2026 Brawley Electric Recreational Off-road Vehicles Due to Injury and Crash Hazards
entry.summary: This recall involves all Model Year 2024-2026 Brawley GTS Electric ROVs. Each vehicle has a unique VIN number located under the dashboard on the driver’s side of the vehicle. The VIN Numbers for the recalled vehicles range from XXXXXXXXXXX005927-XXXXXXXXXXX005990 (2024 models), XXXXXXXXXXX005992- XXXXXXXXXXX006074 (2025 models) and XXXXXXXXXXX006077- XXXXXXXXXXX006152 (2026 models) and can be found under the dashboard on the driver’s side of the vehicle. The Vanderhall logo is located on the bottom of the door on each side of the vehicle. The recalled vehicles were sold in Ivory White, Obsidian Black, Royal Blue, Ida Rose, Bosco Blue, Atomic Green, Rossa, Jean Gray and Emerald Green Metallic colors. Hazard: The seat belts in Brawley ROVs can permanently lockup in the fully retracted position. If this occurs, consumers would be unable to reset the seat belt and put it on when the vehicle is operating, posing injury and crash hazards to consumers. Remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled vehicles immediately and contact an authorized Vanderhall dealer to schedule a free repair. A technician will install an insert into the seat belt guide slot on each seat that will reduce the speed the seat belt retracts, preventing the lockup from occurring. Official CPSC record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: FDA recall: Snack Right Super Foods, Inc. dba Brad's Raw Chips Recalls Brad's Crunchy Kale & Veggie Chips Due to Potential Thallium Contamination
entry.summary: Coral Gables, FL - Snack Right Super Foods, Inc., doing business as Brad's Raw Chips, is recalling certain Brad's Plant Based Crunchy Kale (2 oz) and Brad's Veggie Chips Kale (3 oz) products because they may contain thallium. Official FDA record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: FDA recall: Once Upon A Farm Recalls All Lots and Varieties of Tractor Wheels Organic Toddler Soft-Baked Bars Due to Potential Choking Hazard
entry.summary: Once Upon a Farm (Berkeley, CA) is recalling all lots and varieties of fruit-flavored Tractor Wheel Organic Toddler Soft-Baked bars due to reports that the composition of the Tractor Wheel toddler snack can rapidly hydrate into a dense, dry, and sticky mass upon contact with saliva and during chewing, which can result in a potential choking hazard for toddlers for ages 1.5-2.5 years old. Official FDA record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: FDA recall: SLR Food Distribution Inc. Recalls Wise Wife Brand Ground Cinnamon Due to Elevated Lead Levels
entry.summary: SLR Food Distribution Inc. of Hicksville, New York, is voluntarily recalling Wise Wife Brand Ground Cinnamon because it has the potential to be contaminated with elevated levels of lead. Official FDA record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: FDA recall: HAIFA SMOKED FISH Recalls Cold Smoked Sprats Due to Potential Health Risk
entry.summary: HAIFA SMOKED FISH of QUEENS NY is recalling approximately 560 lbs. of Cold Smoked Sprats, due to potential contamination with Clostridium botulinum , a bacterium which can cause life-threatening illness. Consumers are warned not to use the product even if it does not look or smell spoiled. Official FDA record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: FDA recall: Taylor Farms Issues Recall for H-E-B Backyard BBQ Chop Salad Kit Due to the Potential Undeclared Soy and Tree Nuts(Almonds)
entry.summary: Taylor Farms of Dallas, Texas is recalling H-E-B Backyard BBQ Chop Salad kit due to the potential undeclared soy and tree nuts(almonds). Official FDA record. Not medical or legal advice.

entry.title: FDA recall: Tonight We Ride, LLC Issues Voluntary Recall of Ultimate Forza Male Supplement Due to Presence of Undeclared Sildenafil, Tadalafil, and Dapoxetine
entry.summary: October 24, 2026, Tonight We Ride, LLC of Lakeville, Minnesota is voluntarily recalling all lots of Ultimate Forza Male Supplement capsules to the consumer level because it has been found to contain undeclared Sildenafil, Tadalafil, and Dapoxetine. Official FDA record. Not medical or legal advice.
